channel.title: UniKloSwitcher Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for UniKloSwitcher keyboard switcher.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.3.12
item.description:
• Tray icon blink (accent-tinted) on every layout switch and conversion; icon reflects the auto-switch state.
  • New tray and app icons (keyboard glyph family).
  • Permission preflight at startup: both Accessibility and Input Monitoring are requested explicitly, with automatic pane navigation and per-second retry supervisor — no app relaunch needed after granting.
  • Diagnostic logging of service lifecycle (no user text in release builds).
  • Front-app exclusion menu now uses explicit verbs: «Disable for …» / «Enable for …».
  • Update server and release repository moved to uniKloSwitcher-app.
  • Permissions no longer break after rebuilds: stable code-signing identity is now embedded in TCC records.
  • macOS 15: menu bar icon visibility for LSUIElement apps and settings window activation.
  • Clipboard save/restore no longer materializes file-promise pasteboard content.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.3.28
item.description:
Added

  • Contextual chaining for short words and prepositions (`ShortWords` registry for RU and EN): mistyped short words (e.g. «nj » → «то ») and single-letter prepositions («d » → «в ») are safely held as candidates and converted together when confirmed by the following word («nj есть» → «то есть», «d дороге» → «в дороге», «шт the» → «in the»).
  • Bidirectional chaining support across Russian and English layouts.

Fixed

  • False auto-switch triggers and keystroke corruption when typing valid Russian words:
  • Keys carrying Cyrillic letters that map to punctuation on US layout (б, ю, ж, э, х, ъ) no longer leak Cyrillic letters into the destination accumulation buffer.
  • Added strict guards preventing word self-conversion (`rawWord != dstWord`) and requiring distinct scripts (`rawScript != dstScript`).
  • Active and target layouts are now resolved directly from the physically typed script on screen.
  • Backspacing immediately after an uncommitted short word now safely resets the preposition chain buffer.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.4.3
item.description:
Added

  • Native macOS menu bar layout badge indicator (`EN`, `RU`, etc.): filled plate with cutout text when active, outline plate when paused, disabled, or dormant on an unsupported layout; accent-color flash on layout switch. Configurable in Settings → General («Menu Bar Icon Style: Layout Badge / Keyboard»).
  • Multi-layout safety gate (3+ layouts): auto-switch and hotkey word conversion strictly engage only when the active layout is English or Russian, leaving 3rd-party layouts (e.g. `de`, `uk`, `fr`) completely untouched.

Fixed

  • Calibrated trigram threshold (`minTargetScore = -3.8`) allowing tech terms and loanwords with rare Cyrillic trigrams (such as `,tql;` → `бейдж`) to auto-convert seamlessly.
  • Menu bar layout badge proportions refined: narrower width and taller height matching native macOS capsule controls.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.5.2
item.description:
Added

  • Secure Input Protection & HUD Notice**: Complete isolation of password and terminal `sudo` sessions via `IsSecureEventInputEnabled()` and IOKit process resolution (`kCGSSessionSecureInputPID`). Auto-switching and hotkey conversions immediately bail without touching password fields, and an unobtrusive, click-through non-activating HUD overlay informs the user.
  • Bilingual Localization (EN / RU)**: Automatic system language detection (`Locale.current`) with manual language override in Settings (`System / English / Русский`). Full 100% localization across HUD notices, menu bar items, tooltips, and all 4 Settings tabs (`General`, `Auto-Switch`, `Hotkeys`, `About`).
  • Extended Pause Options**: Added «Until Tomorrow» (`pauseUntilTomorrow`) and clarified pause durations in the menu bar (`15 Minutes`, `30 Minutes`, `1 Hour`, `Until Tomorrow`).
  • HUD Preview Button**: Interactive test button in Settings → General to preview the Secure Input notice layout and typography directly on screen.

Changed

  • Secure Input HUD Typography & Layout**: Compact, focused HUD linked directly to macOS system typography (`NSFont.systemFontSize`), featuring a security shield icon, concise scannable copy, and a non-activating `.statusBar` floating window level.

Fixed

  • Asymmetric Fail-Closed Secure Input Cache**: Cached `true` for 100ms during active password typing to eliminate WindowServer IPC overhead, while never caching `false` (0ms lag when entering password fields).
  • Third-Party & Alternative Layouts**: Unified layout support under a single core predicate `isLayoutSupported` shared by both auto-switch and manual hotkeys, fully supporting 3rd-party Cyrillic layouts lacking TIS language tags (e.g. Ilya Birman Typography).
  • Clean UI Layout Codes (`displayLanguageCode`)**: Introduced robust 2-letter uppercase display code resolution for menu bar badges and floating language chips, permanently eliminating `?→?` notices on layouts with missing TIS language tags.
  • AX Messaging Timeout**: Applied strict 0.25s timeouts on accessibility queries to prevent beachballs when interacting with unresponsive applications.
  • Language Detection Fallback**: Aligned system language resolution so non-Russian system locales fall back cleanly to English standard interface, with reactive Settings window title updates upon language change.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.5.3
item.description:
Fixed

  • Slash as Word Boundary**: Added slash (`/`) as a recognized word boundary trigger in the auto-correction engine. Mistyped words followed immediately by a slash (e.g. `yfcnhjqrb/разработки`) now convert instantly at the slash (`настройки/`), switching the system layout to Russian for the subsequent word.
  • Buffer & Raw Keystroke Synchronization**: Synchronized raw keystroke tracking with destination word accumulation in `WordBuffer`, preventing raw buffer residue upon buffer resets (e.g. typing a slash or digits on an empty buffer). Fixes the bug where auto-correcting a word following a slash sent an extra Backspace that deleted the preceding slash (`настройкиразработки` → `настройки/разработки`).
  • Accurate Deletion Range**: Eliminated double-counting of trailing punctuation in auto-correction backspace calculations, guaranteeing that only the typed characters belonging to the word and its trail are erased.
  • Punctuation Key Preservation**: Refined `nextBufferChar` to preserve genuine punctuation keys (such as `/`) as typed when neither the source nor the destination mapping is an alphabetic letter.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.5.4
item.description:
Fixed

  • Preposition & Short-Word Chaining**: Fixed a regression where unanchored candidate short words (e.g. `nj` → `то`, `d` → `в`) were prematurely discarded from memory upon buffer reset instead of being preserved for contextual conversion with the following word (`nj есть` → `то есть`).

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.5.5
item.description:
Fixed

  • Contextual Chaining & Mutual Confirmation for Short Words**: Fixed an issue where phrases starting with multiple short words (such as `z nen` → `я тут` or `z nen поправил` → `я тут поправил`) were blocked from converting. Recognized 3-letter prepositions, particles, and adverbs in `ShortWords` (e.g. `тут`, `где`, `как`, `для`, `под`, `над`) are now properly classified as short-word candidates instead of being routed through the strict trigram garbage threshold. Consecutive recognized short words now mutually confirm the target language and convert immediately together, switching the system layout without requiring an extra long word.
  • Symmetric Latin Short-Word Registry**: Expanded `ShortWords.latin` with common 3-letter words (`the`, `and`, `for`, `you`, `not`, etc.) to symmetrically guard against false-positive conversions on English typing and support reverse chaining from Cyrillic layout.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.6.0
item.description:
Fixed

  • Dynamic Winner & Layout-Agnostic Punctuation Awareness**: Resolved conversion failures for words typed in the wrong layout ending in punctuation (such as `future.` typed on Russian layout producing `агегкую `). Introduced Path 2 (Dynamic Winner) in trigram decision scoring: when the target word has high naturalness ($s_{\text{alt}} \ge -2.85$) and the typed form is in the non-native zone ($s_{\text{typed}} < -3.3$), the word converts dynamically with sensitivity-scaled margin. Dynamically detects punctuation intent across any installed Russian keyboard layout (Standard Mac, PC, Typewriter, Birman) without hardcoding characters by comparing destination punctuation against raw letters.
  • Sparkle Appcast CI/CD Race Condition**: Fixed an issue where Sparkle update downloads failed with «_An error occurred while downloading the update. Please try again later_». In `.github/workflows/release.yml`, reordered steps so the GitHub Release with the binary `.zip` asset is published and verified _before_ pushing the updated `appcast.xml` to the public repository.
  • Contextual Chaining & Mutual Confirmation for Short Words**: Fixed an issue where phrases starting with multiple short words (such as `z nen` → `я тут` or `z nen поправил` → `я тут поправил`) were blocked from converting. Recognized 3-letter prepositions, particles, and adverbs in `ShortWords` (e.g. `тут`, `где`, `как`, `для`, `под`, `над`) are now properly classified as short-word candidates instead of being routed through the strict trigram garbage threshold. Consecutive recognized short words now mutually confirm the target language and convert immediately together, switching the system layout without requiring an extra long word.
  • Symmetric Latin Short-Word Registry**: Expanded `ShortWords.latin` with common 3-letter words (`the`, `and`, `for`, `you`, `not`, etc.) to symmetrically guard against false-positive conversions on English typing and support reverse chaining from Cyrillic layout.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.6.2
item.description:
Changed

  • Soft Tray Icon Border**: Added a theme-adaptive soft border to both menu bar icon styles. The active layout badge (EN / RU) now carries an inner frame — a 0.75 pt semi-transparent ring cut into the filled plate — and the paused/disabled outline plate stroke is softened from 85% to 60% opacity. Keyboard glyphs gain a soft silhouette halo (1.4 px, 35% alpha) built from a dilation of the glyph mask. Both borders live inside the template alpha mask, so macOS renders them dark on light and light on dark menu bars without per-appearance code; the accent-color switch blink covers them as before.

Fixed

  • Removed the deprecated `showsResizeIndicator` assignment in the Settings window controller (no-op since macOS 15), silencing a deprecation warning in release builds.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.6.3
item.description:
Added

  • Undo for Auto-Corrections: Pressing the conversion hotkey within 1.5 s after an automatic correction restores the text as typed and the original layout, as long as nothing was typed or clicked since.
  • Mid-Word Layout Switch in Auto Mode: Words typed partly in each layout are repaired at the word boundary — ghjсто → просто (layout switched mid-word) and приdtn → привет (wrong layout picked mid-word). Intentional hyphenated mixes (SQL-запрос, iPhone-ом) are left alone.
  • Input Monitoring Status: Settings → General and the menu bar menu now show whether Input Monitoring is granted (without it macOS delivers no keystrokes) and open the right System Settings pane.

Changed

  • Switch Target Follows Your Layouts: Auto-switching and the hotkey now switch to the layout of the other script you last typed in (ABC, U.S. International, Dvorak, Russian – PC…) instead of always ABC / Russian.
  • Hotkey Word Conversion via Accessibility: Without a selection, the word before the caret is selected and replaced directly through Accessibility — no synthetic ⌘⇧← keystrokes, no clipboard, and the rest of the line (formatting, links, mentions) is never rewritten.
  • Option + Space Hotkey: Registered as a system hot key, so the key press no longer types a no-break space over the text being converted.
  • Electron Apps Stay Light: Chromium/Electron accessibility trees (Slack, Discord, VS Code) are only woken for manual conversions, never by background auto-correction.
  • Clipboard Managers: Temporary paste text and the restored clipboard are marked transient, so they no longer appear in clipboard history; the clipboard is not touched at all when a copy attempt copied nothing.
  • Minimum System Version: Info.plist and the update feed now declare macOS 15.0, matching the binary.

Fixed

  • Shortcuts Corrupting Text: ⌘/⌃ shortcuts (⌘Z, ⌘V, ⌘S…) were buffered as letters and could make a later correction delete neighbouring text; ⌘Tab, ⌃Tab, ⌘Space and ⌘/ after a mistyped word were swallowed and replaced by a literal Tab, space or slash. Shortcuts now reset the word buffer and are never word boundaries.
  • Word / Line Deletion: ⌥⌫ and ⌘⌫ shortened the buffer by a single character only; they now reset it.
  • Tab Between Fields: A pending short-word candidate no longer survives Tab, which could delete text in the next form field. The boundary key is now re-posted as the real key event (keeps Tab focus navigation working in browsers).
  • Fast Typing During a Correction: Keystrokes held back while a word is retyped are now replayed in the new layout and fed into the word buffer (previously they kept the old layout and the next word was evaluated from its middle); ordering is preserved, and a 1 s watchdog guarantees typing can never freeze if a correction hangs.
  • Contractions Typed in the Wrong Layout: Шэь / вщтэе now convert to I'm / don't (the apostrophe no longer splits the word).
  • Punctuation Hint on Aggressive Sensitivity: The punctuation hint could make the Dynamic Winner margin stricter instead of looser.
  • Hotkey Without Selection in VS Code / JetBrains: ⌘C is no longer used when Accessibility reports an empty selection (these editors copy the whole line), which duplicated the line.
  • Double Hotkey Press: A second press during a running conversion no longer starts an interleaving second pipeline, and conversions never overlap an auto-correction.
  • Launch at Login: Errors are reported instead of silently leaving the toggle on; pending approval in Login Items is explained.
  • Duplicate Permission Prompt at first launch removed; layout-change notifications are published once per change.

Security & Release

  • Builds are signed by the certificate SHA-1 instead of its name, and sign_release.sh verifies the certificate leaf before publishing; scripts that generate a new certificate now require an explicit flag.
  • The release workflow skips versions that are already published (unless forced), verifies the uploaded archive byte-for-byte before updating the appcast, refuses empty EdDSA signatures, and runs one release at a time.

item.description: • Pass release

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.6.5
item.description:
Fixed

  • "UniKlo Paused" Notice While Typing Passwords: Typing capital letters in a password field, sudo or a Terminal with Secure Keyboard Entry could be mistaken for a Double Shift / Option tap and pop up the secure input notice. Modifier-tap hotkeys are now ignored while Secure Input is active (macOS hides the typed letters from the app there); Option + Space still shows the notice.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.6.6
item.description:
Fixed

  • Hotkeys Tab Input Visibility & Undo Hotkey Clarity: The Try It sandbox text field now uses a visible rounded-border style (previously rendered as borderless placeholder text on macOS 26 grouped forms). Added an explicit «Undo Hotkey» row next to the conversion hotkey picker showing that undo uses the same key within a 1.5 s window.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.6.7
item.description:
Fixed

  • Stuck Tooltip Near the Menu Bar: The hover tooltip on the tray icon ("UniKloSwitcher [EN] (Active)") could stay frozen on screen after an auto-switch: rewriting the tooltip while it was visible orphaned its window, and it disappeared only on the next layout change. The tooltip is removed entirely — the tray badge (filled vs outline plate) and the click menu still show the auto-switch state.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.0
item.description:
Added

  • Dark-Red Permission Alert in Menu Bar: Shows an adaptive dark-red icon across Layout Badge, classic keyboard SVG, and fallback symbols whenever Accessibility or Input Monitoring permissions are missing.
  • Learned Auto-Correction Exceptions: Undoing an auto-correction remembers the source word so UniKlo does not fight your vocabulary again (with a reset button in Settings → Auto-Switch).
  • Instant Short-Word Answers: Unambiguous standalone replies (да, нет, yes, no, как, что, not, and, the, etc.) convert immediately on Space or Return without waiting for a second context word, while ignoring uppercase acronyms.
  • Auto-Correct Before Return / ⌘Return: Fixes a mistyped word right before sending a chat message (Return, ⌘+Return) or inserting a newline (Return, Shift+Return) without carrying Undo or multi-word context across lines (toggleable in Settings → Auto-Switch; switches layout for the next line even when disabled).
  • Browser Layout Memory Control: Browsers are skipped by default during per-app layout restoration on window activation so per-tab native layouts are not overridden (opt-in toggle available in Settings → General).

Changed

  • Longer Undo Window & Expanded ShortWords: Increased the Undo window from 1.5 s to 4.5 s and expanded recognized 2–3 letter ShortWords in Russian and English.
  • Quieter Sparkle Background Updates: Deferred the first scheduled background update check (SULastCheckTime seeded on first launch) and skipped background checks until permissions are active, while manual "Check for Updates…" remains available anytime.

Fixed

  • **Native Layout Switching in Browsers & Apps (Ctrl+Space, Fn, Caps Lock)**: Switched per-app layout tracking to MacLayout.inputSourceDidChangeNotification, added manual-switch priority guards so in-flight corrections never revert a concurrent native layout switch, and synced Caps Lock / Fn layout transitions.
  • Browser Manual Conversion & Omnibox Inline Autocomplete: Manual conversion now captures the active typing buffer before line-grab fallbacks and handles empty-string kAXSelectedTextAttribute responses in Chromium/Electron; auto-correction safely clears highlighted inline Omnibox suggestions without accepting them, passes target virtual keyCodes on retype, and remaps kVK_ANSI_Slash boundaries (ghbdtn/ → привет. on Russian-PC).
  • Permission Relaunch Safety: Eliminated redundant permission polling and added a single-shot relaunch guard when Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions arrive mid-run.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.1
item.description:
Added

  • Diagonal Layout Flag Menu Bar Style: Replaced the classic keyboard icon option in Settings → Appearance with a crisp vector Layout Flag mode (20×14pt, -30° rotated RU / US / UK flags inside a fixed rounded mask, dimmed in color when auto-switching is paused or off, with an accent border flash on switch and red badge alert when permissions are missing).

Changed

  • Compact Apple HIG Menu Bar Icon: Scaled the default EN / RU layout badge down to 20×14pt (9pt semibold) with optical CTLineDraw centering, clean 1.0pt Retina-aligned outline when paused, fixed 2-letter width without inner cutout noise, and live light/dark appearance adaptation for tinted warning/accent states.

Fixed

  • **Repeated Conversions After Return & Layout Cache Desync**: Typing mistyped short words (such as jr + Return → ок) repeatedly or right after Caps Lock / Fn / focus layout changes now keeps working on the second and subsequent tries — per-keystroke script inference in AutoCorrectionService recovers immediately from stale input-source snapshots while MacLayout reconciles asynchronously after select and modifier transitions.
  • CI Test Compatibility: Marked the live RU+EN boundary integration check with LayoutRequirement.ruAndEn so CI runners without a Russian layout skip it cleanly while pure whitelist and stale-snapshot recovery tests run everywhere.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.2
item.description:
Fixed

  • **Partial Word Capture on Cyrillic Letters Mapping to Latin Punctuation (ж, б, ю, х, ъ) & Caret Moves**: WordBuffer no longer splits or drops prefixes of Russian words when ж/б/ю/х/ъ appear at the start or mid-word (e.g. менеджеру stays whole instead of splitting off еру → the, while preserving future. / about, end-of-word punctuation hints), and AutoCorrectionService resets the buffer explicitly on arrow/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown/ForwardDelete/Escape navigation keys.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.3
item.description:
Added

  • Color Badge (EN / RU) Menu Bar Style: Added a third icon option in Settings → Appearance with crisp 20×14pt flag-inspired gradients (blue-to-red for RU, deep indigo-to-blue for EN), white 9pt semibold/bold glyphs, dimmed appearance when paused, and a bright flash border on switches.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.4
item.description:
Fixed

  • Punctuation Translation on Auto-Switch: Auto-correction now translates both trailing punctuation (e.g., ghbdtn& → привет?, ghbdtn^ → привет:, руддщ, → hello?) and clean word-leading punctuation (@ghbdtn@ → "привет") using the physical (keyCode, Shift) mapping of the user's active target layout, while preserving Option-modified symbols, manual mid-word layout switches, and leading # hashtags as exceptions.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.5
item.description:
Changed

  • **Standard-Height Menu Bar Icons (23×16pt)**: Upscaled all three menu bar icon styles (Layout Badge, Color Badge, and Layout Flag) from 20×14pt (9pt font) to 23×16pt (10.5pt font, 3.5pt corner radius) on the 18pt canvas so they match the visual height and weight of neighboring macOS menu bar icons.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.6
item.description:
Changed

  • **High-Contrast Color Badge (20×14pt)**: Returned all three menu bar icon styles (Layout Badge, Color Badge, and Layout Flag) to compact 20×14pt proportions (9pt font, 3pt corner radius) and updated the Color Badge palette to Apple System Vivid gradients (#FF3B30 → #C81E1E for RU, #0A84FF → #0055D4 for EN) with a 0.6pt inner highlight rim when active for crisp contrast across light, dark, and translucent menu bars.

Added

  • Smart Abbreviation & Technical Token Protection: Added a 4-layer AbbreviationGuard protecting 2–5 uppercase acronyms typed with Shift (while still auto-correcting words typed with an accidental Caps Lock, such as GHBDTN → ПРИВЕТ), CamelCase identifiers (iOS, macOS, GitHub) without blocking stuck-Shift typos (GHbdtn → Привет), collision-audited lowercased abbreviations (json, html, yaml, grpc, sql, ssh, ндфл, снилс), technical prefixes/extensions (.env, --yaml, config.toml, application/tls), and case-aware ALL CAPS Undo exceptions.
  • Menu Bar Preview Template: Saved interactive operator preview template at docs/menubar-badge-preview.html for comparing icon sizes, scales, and color palettes across Light/Dark menu bars and Active/Paused/Flash states.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.7
item.description:
Changed

  • **High-Contrast Color Badge (22×16pt)**: Kept Layout Badge and Layout Flag at compact 20×14pt proportions while sizing Color Badge to 22×16pt (10pt Bold, 3.75pt corner radius) to match the 16pt height of native macOS menu bar pills, using Apple System Vivid gradients (#FF3B30 → #C81E1E for RU, #0A84FF → #0055D4 for EN) with crisp borderless edges when active (borders reserved for switch flash and pause states).

Fixed

  • **Double-Shift Undo Clean Replacement (неаytf / нytw)**: Replaced fragile unverified Shift+Left selection sequences during Undo with atomic Accessibility suffix replacement (axReplaceSuffixBeforeCaret) and paced Backspace + typeUnicode fallback for non-AX editors, preventing partial/zero-selection glitches that glued reverted text next to the original word.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.8
item.description:
Added

  • **Mistyped URL Schemes, Domains, Dotfiles & RU→EN Technical Dictionary (реезыЖ.. → https://)**: Added immediate mid-typing auto-conversion for Cyrillic-typed URI prefixes (https://, http://, ssh://, ftp://, ws://, etc. on both Russian-PC Ж.. and Apple Russian Ж/), www. (цццю), and colon prefixes (localhost: / mailto:), plus collision-audited RU→EN support for standalone IT/CLI/protocol terms (yaml, html, grpc, json, sudo, curl, docker, kubectl, etc.), dotted domains/dotfiles (google.com, ya.ru, .env, .gitignore), and --flag CLI arguments (--json, --help).

Fixed

  • **Underscore & snake_case Auto-Conversion (ца_Ыгиы / ца_Subs → wf_Subs)**: Folded internal single _ characters inside WordBuffer and split underscore/dot segments in TrigramModel.score and autoDecideMixed, preventing .restarted from discarding the left half of snake_case identifiers while keeping EN-typed snake_case (user_id, my_var, wf_Subs) protected.

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.9
item.description:
Fixed

  • Status Bar KVO 100% CPU Loop & Energy Impact: Ignored redundant effectiveAppearance KVO callbacks when the theme (dark/light) has not changed and skipped no-op NSStatusBarButton.image / needsDisplay updates, stopping an infinite _updateReplicants redraw loop on macOS (NSStatusItem / MenuBarAgent).
  • Pre-Rasterized Menu Bar Icons: Baked 1× and 2× Retina NSBitmapImageRep bitmaps in sRGB instead of lazy NSCustomImageRep drawing closures so replicant snapshots blit directly without re-running CGGradient, ColorSync, or CoreText.
  • Zero-Wakeup Pause Expiration: Replaced the permanent 30s pauseTicker polling timer with a single one-shot timer scheduled strictly until pauseUntil (plus NSWorkspace.didWakeNotification).

item.title: UniKloSwitcher 1.7.10
item.description:
Changed

  • **Release Versioning Policy (AGENTS.md)**: Documented mandatory version bumping in CHANGELOG.md and VERSION synchronization via scripts/get_version.sh before every build/release so Sparkle updates trigger reliably.
